gate.name: Moon Gate
gate.desc: A silver gate stands under a dead moon painted on the stone. A key lies in the dust.

court.name: The Court
court.desc: The court is empty of courtiers. It is not empty of guards. The gallery is north.

gallery.name: The Gallery
gallery.desc: Portraits of kings with the faces scratched out. A mask on the north lintel waits.

dais.name: The Dais
dais.desc: Three steps up. Two thick red vials sit on the last one, left for someone who would need them.

throne.name: The Night Throne
throne.desc: The throne is black iron. The king has been waiting.

moon_gate.success_msg: The gate opens without a sound.
moon_gate.fail_msg: Nothing you hold belongs to this lock.

coffin_riddle.desc: The mask asks: 'The one who makes it does not need it. The one who buys it does not use it. The one who uses it does not know it. What is it?'
coffin_riddle.success_msg: The mask shuts its eyes. The way north is open.
coffin_riddle.hint: One word. It is a house for someone who will not come home.
